doubts.Q9: NCERT classes salts by the pH of their solution, so NaHCO3 is a basic salt; a setter using the older 'acid salt' (replaceable H) classification would key 'Acidic salt'.
doubts.Q13: Increasing acidic strength is D, C, A, B, which is the sequence of the first option, but every option is printed with '>' signs, and read as an inequality the second option (B > A > C > D) is the true statement; same in the Hindi.
